title: Mathematics-I IIT Roorkee
description: **Welcome to webpage of MAN-001 (Mathematics-I) course.**. **This is a compulsory course for all first year undergraduate students.** **Here, you can find important notices, assignments and other stuff related to** **this course** **for the Autumn Semester 2020-21.**. **Objective:** To provide essential knowledge of basic tools of Differential Calculus, Integral Calculus , Vector Calculus and Matrix Algebra for degree students. **Matrix Algebra:** Elementary operations and their use in getting the Rank, Inverse of a matrix and solution of linear simultaneous equations. **Differential Calculus:**Limit, Continuity and differentiability of functions of two variables, Euler’s theorem for homogeneous equations, Tangent plane and normal. **Integral Calculus:**Review of curve tracing and quadric surfaces, Double and Triple integrals, Change of order of integration, Change of variables, Gamma and Beta functions, Dirichlet’s integral, Applications of Multiple integrals such as surface area, volumes, centre of gravity and moment of inertia. **TA 20:** This part will be evaluated by the Tutorial Assistant (TA) on the basis of timely submission of assignments and performance in the tutorials. **Deputy Coordinator:** **Prof.** **Mahendra Kumar Verma**.
